description: Where a wallet's money came from and where it went over the last days, on Robinhood Chain (default), HyperEVM, Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum: every counterparty that sent it or received tokens from it, grouped and priced in USD (today's prices), with transfer counts, the tokens moved and first and last dates. Counterparties are marked wallet or contract, and labelled when they're registered ERC-8004 agents or well-known contracts (never people). Also the first money in within the window, often what funded it. Use to trace a deployer's sells, a seller's buyers, or where funds were sent.

days.description: How far back, in days. Default 30, max 90

token.description: Optional token contract to follow as well (e.g. the token a deployer launched), in case the wallet no longer holds it

name: wallet_flows
title: Follow the money (a wallet's flows)
